**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves ToLua / LuaJIT 2.1 VM & IL2CPP MiniMap/Radar offsets across game updates
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Clean option layout with draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v4.13.1**
